description: Change the user's daily brief: add or remove insight channels (their own; ids from list_insight_channels or create_insight_channel), when it runs, its tone and length, or turn it on/off. If the user is still on the shared house brief, their own brief is created from it first, so adding a channel adds to what they already get. Confirm the change with the user first. Costs 0 credits.

active.description: Turn the brief on or off

frequency.description: How often it runs. Default daily.

timezone.description: The user's IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York. Ask the user if you don't know it; if omitted, their daily brief's zone (else America/New_York) is used.

name: update_daily_brief
title: Update daily brief
